A named provider that nothing consumes still has its parameters
validated against the available bindings.
-- go.mod --
module app

-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- store/store.go --
package store

type DB struct{ Addr string }

type Audit struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=replica
func NewReplicaDB(a *Audit) *DB { return &DB{Addr: "replica"} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"app/store"
)

type API struct {
	DB *store.DB
}

//fabrik:http GET /api
func (a *API) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
